checks.result: only non-destructive warning text matched in connector/integration surfaces

acceptance_evidence.reference: The independent test starts the real app-owned backend and private socket, registers a session, writes retained evidence, drives the built MCP executable through discovery, explain-growth, task-impact, export, cleanup-candidate, and rejected destructive calls, compares app/MCP export detail, checks exact forbidden keys and response bounds, repeats human snapshot/export and click/menu contracts, then stops the app service and verifies an actionable app_unavailable result. Isolated client tests and all inherited scenarios pass in the same 83-test build.

discovered_risks: Timestamp ordering at session-registration boundaries must remain explicit; events preceding registration correctly stay unknown.
Endpoint Security exact provenance is intentionally outside this increment, so workspace-only task impact remains inferred.
Current stdio request handling is sequential; cancellation checks bound connector IPC, but a later notification cannot preempt an already-blocked request in the same line-oriented process.
